title: Is ETHICS about ethics? Evaluating the ETHICS benchmark
benchmark_measurement: This paper evaluates the ETHICS benchmark, which focuses on general moral theories (deontology, utilitarianism, virtue ethics). The paper does not mention any measurement related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not analyze or present any findings related to religion, faith, or religious ethics. Its focus is a philosophical and psychological critique of the ETHICS benchmark's methodology for evaluating moral reasoning in language models.
